front.title: An Experimental Post-Quantum Cryptographic Profile for DNP3 Secure Authentication Version 5

abstract.t:
This document specifies an experimental post-quantum cryptographic profile for DNP3 Secure Authentication version 5 (SAv5). It defines an ML-KEM-768 and ML-DSA authentication exchange, HKDF-SHA-256 session keys, canonical DNP3 application protocol data unit (APDU) encoding, transport segmentation, and HMAC-SHA-256 protection of application messages.
The APDU uses DNP3 application control, authentication function codes, response internal indications, and a length-delimited experimental authentication object. The reference implementation includes binary encoders and decoders, link CRC processing, transport reassembly, key confirmation, replay checks, and executable test vectors. The post-quantum object selector is a local experimental value, subject to allocation by the DNP3 standards owner; this document does not assign an IEEE or IEC algorithm or object variation.
